tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms & conditions are as per tender documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder must have minimum average annual turnover for preceding continuous three financial years for providing Man power supply services. Bidder must have at least twice the approximate tender value of respective divisions. In support Bidder need to submit duly supported Audited Statement of Accounts i.e. Profit/ Loss Statements, Balance Sheets and GST returns for preceding continuous three financial years. (i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The Bidders should submit Xerox copy of audited statement of accounts sealed and signed by self (bidder) and the Chartered Accountant along with the pre-qualification offer. CA certificate in the format prescribed shall be uploaded in the e-procurement portal.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- SUBMIT THE DOCUMENTS AS PER THE PREQUALIFICATION CRITERIA OF THE TENDER.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidders shall necessarily possess following documents at the time of uploading the tender and should upload the same in the e- procurement portal. Certification of Incorporation under Shops and Commercial Establishment Act 1961 issued by Department of Labour. Provident Fund Registration Certificate issued by the Regional Provident Fund Commissioner. Combined Challan having TRRN No. for having remitted PF returns to PF authority for all the 36 months of last three Financial Years. GST Registration Certificate. Certificate of Registration under Professional Tax Act. Copy of the PAN card of the Bidders/ Proprietors. Documents for having paid the Labour Welfare Fund for at least 50 employees to Labour Department during last three years put together.
